description: Angular component for configuring MQTT device transport settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, data binding, and integration with application state.

classes.name: MqttDeviceTransportConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for MQTT device transport configuration, managing form state and data propagation.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback, not implemented.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches the form with a new value for the configuration.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model based on form value and sets the transport type to MQTT.
